# Action

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Actions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Action)*

On your turn, you can take one action. Choose which action to take from those below or from the special actions provided by your features. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Actions](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Actions)"). These actions are defined elsewhere in this glossary:

- [Attack](Attack.md)
- [Dash](Dash.md)
- [Disengage](Disengage.md)
- [Dodge](Dodge.md)
- [Help](Help.md)
- [Hide](Hide.md)
- [Influence](Influence.md)
- [Magic](Magic.md)
- [Ready](Ready.md)
- [Search](Search.md)
- [Study](Study.md)
- [Utilize](Utilize.md)
